title: Router REPLAN dispatch under fleet mode must designate a worktree (or sanctioned scratch cwd)
problem: Half 2 of null-failreasons-capture (half 1 — seal-time FailReasons backfill — landed in PR #442). The one diagnosed null-reason mechanism: advisor/router REPLAN dispatch under fleet mode launched without a designated worktree and was correctly refused (cycle-1358 router-launch-error.txt). The refusal is now at least VISIBLE in FailReasons via the backfill; the dispatch itself remains broken.
fix: Designate the worktree on the replan dispatch path (the lane's own worktree when one exists) or fall back to a sanctioned scratch cwd for the router agent under fleet mode.
acceptance: A fleet-mode REPLAN dispatch launches with a designated cwd (no refusal); regression test over the router dispatch seam; wiring proof.
